item.description:

あらすじ

One time at a live, the huge idol fan Homura came across a path where those affiliated with idols crossed. Out of sheer curiosity, he tried to sneak in and possibly meet an idol. However, he was quickly noticed and ran away, hiding in a side room. That’s when he came face-to-face with his favourite idol, Nere. He was moved at the chance meeting, but something was amiss.

item.title: Mamono Musume no Sodatekata ~Lamia & Harpy~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Vanadis
  • 発売日: 2017-01-27
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔物娘の育て方～ラミア＆ハーピー～
  • 英語名: Mamono Musume no Sodatekata Lamia & Harpy

あらすじ

This is the latest game in Vanadis’ Mamono Musume series. Riku was eating his bento at the top of a mountain when the boiled egg that he was peeling slipped out of his hand. It started rolling down the slope and he chased after it, but it wouldn’t stop. He was left in despair as it ended up rolling into a nearby lake. Perhaps out of pity seeing his love for eggs, a goddess appeared form the lake holding two eggs. He was given the choice of the golden egg or the silver egg. In the end, he ended up with both of them.

  • 日本語名: 聖もんむす学園
  • 英語名: Sei Monmusu Gakuen

别名

  • st. Monmusu Gakuen

あらすじ

Shink arrived at the school with the intention of being a teacher that will help guide the students towards their goals… but this wasn’t a normal school! Actually, the school was built for monster girls to help them learn how to coexist with humans. He was apprehensive, but was convinced to become the homeroom teacher for the most problematic class. The students skip class, look down on him as a human, try to seduce him or even look at him as food. Will he be able to fulfill his role as their teacher properly and help them graduate?

あらすじ

Amidst a war between humans and monsters, the spider princess Arachne was at the height of her boredom. She spent every day stuck in a castle in the middle of nowhere, watching the same mundane events play out over and over. She even tried to provoke her assistants, the harpy Rupuia and the cyclops Cyc, into some fiery entertainment to no avail. At her wits’ end, Arachne came up with a new plan to rid herself of boredom - a summoning ritual.

item.title: Mamono Musume to no Seikatsu ~Alraune no Baai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Vanadis
  • 発売日: 2010-04-16
  • スコア: 6.57/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔物娘との性活～アルラウネの場合～
  • 英語名: Mamono Musume to no Seikatsu Alraune no Baai

あらすじ

Reiku is a pharmacist, who everyday visits the grave of his dead lover Arun. One day, he notices a flower sprouting from her grave and begins to take care of the sprout. The sprout eventually transforms into a plant girl with the same face as his dead lover. The plant girl is a Alraune, a monster birthed from the blood of the dead Arun. Reiku treats the plant girl like a daughter and gives her a name Aruru. However, Aruru is a monster and needs to suck “vitality” of other creatures to survive, and the way that she gets to do it, is by eating Reiku’s semen. Now, to feed his plant daughter, Reiku needs to offer his semen everyday to her, and he does it with pleasure, since he loves his plant daughter very much.
